commands.name: SFC verification

commands.consequences: No intentional configuration change. Windows may write operational logs.

commands.name: SFC repair
commands.description: Scan and repair protected system files.
commands.consequences: Scan and repair protected system files.

commands.name: DISM quick health check
commands.description: Read recorded component-store health; servicing can update metadata.
commands.consequences: Read recorded component-store health; servicing can update metadata.

commands.name: DISM health scan
commands.description: Scan the component store; servicing can update metadata.
commands.consequences: Scan the component store; servicing can update metadata.

commands.name: DISM repair (local sources)
commands.description: Repair the component store with Windows Update fallback disabled.
commands.consequences: Repair the component store with Windows Update fallback disabled.

commands.name: Read-only filesystem check
commands.description: CHKDSK without repair switches. Active-volume reports may be misleading.
commands.consequences: No intentional configuration change. Windows may write operational logs.

commands.name: Reset Winsock
commands.description: Reset socket providers; networking software may be affected and a restart may be needed.
commands.consequences: Removes custom Winsock providers. Connectivity and networking software may be affected. A restart may be needed; none will be scheduled.

commands.name: Preview temporary-file cleanup
commands.description: Preview at most 200 regular files older than seven days in your local Temp directory.
commands.consequences: Permanently deletes only the previewed eligible files. There is no undo.

commands.name: Windows Defender status
commands.description: Query Defender status when its Windows module is available.
commands.consequences: No intentional configuration change. Windows may write operational logs.

commands.name: Firewall status
commands.description: Query Windows firewall profiles without changing them.
commands.consequences: No intentional configuration change. Windows may write operational logs.

commands.name: Local user accounts
commands.description: Query local accounts without the architecture-specific LocalAccounts module.
commands.consequences: No intentional configuration change. Windows may write operational logs.

commands.name: Device Manager
commands.description: Open device administration; changing devices can disrupt the system.
commands.consequences: Opens an administrative interface whose controls can modify Windows. Its subsequent actions are outside the toolkit.

commands.name: Computer Management
commands.description: Open Windows administration tools with broad modification capabilities.
commands.consequences: Opens an administrative interface whose controls can modify Windows. Its subsequent actions are outside the toolkit.

commands.name: Windows security settings
commands.description: Open the Windows Security settings page.
commands.consequences: Opens an administrative interface whose controls can modify Windows. Its subsequent actions are outside the toolkit.

commands.name: Full specifications
commands.description: Choose Full, Hardware, Firmware (motherboard and BIOS), Windows, Storage or Network specifications. Unavailable sections do not discard successful sections.
commands.consequences: Queries local information without applying repairs.

commands.name: Recent critical and error events
commands.description: Up to 50 critical/error events per System and Application log.
commands.consequences: Queries local information without applying repairs.

commands.name: Problem devices
commands.description: Devices reporting configuration or driver errors.
commands.consequences: Queries local information without applying repairs.

commands.name: Battery health indicators
commands.description: Firmware-reported design and full-charge capacities where available.
commands.consequences: Queries local information without applying repairs.

commands.name: Windows Update diagnostics
commands.description: Local update services, restart indicators, policy and toolbox suspension state. No update scan is started.
commands.consequences: Queries local information without applying repairs.

commands.name: Connectivity diagnostic
commands.description: Inspect the IPv4 gateway, DNS resolution and TCP connectivity to your explicit target.
commands.consequences: Queries local information without applying repairs.

commands.name: Firewall enable / disable
commands.description: Enable protection or disable selected profiles in timed/manual mode. Effective policy is verified.
commands.consequences: Enable protection or disable selected profiles in timed/manual mode. Effective policy is verified. Changes run only after confirmation; scheduled features create protected recovery files and Windows tasks.

commands.name: Restore toolbox firewall changes
commands.description: Restore original profile settings from toolbox snapshots. Conflicting external changes are not overwritten.
commands.consequences: Restore original profile settings from toolbox snapshots. Conflicting external changes are not overwritten. Changes run only after confirmation; scheduled features create protected recovery files and Windows tasks.

commands.name: Defender real-time protection
commands.description: Enable or disable real-time protection in timed/manual mode. Tamper Protection is never bypassed.
commands.consequences: Enable or disable real-time protection in timed/manual mode. Tamper Protection is never bypassed. Changes run only after confirmation; scheduled features create protected recovery files and Windows tasks.

commands.name: Restore toolbox Defender change
commands.description: Restore the original real-time protection state from the toolbox snapshot.
commands.consequences: Restore the original real-time protection state from the toolbox snapshot. Changes run only after confirmation; scheduled features create protected recovery files and Windows tasks.

commands.name: Suspend automatic updates (1-36 months)
commands.description: Apply local automatic-update policy on supported unmanaged editions. Manual updates remain available. A dated restoration task is required.

parameters.name: months
parameters.label: Calendar months to suspend automatic updates

commands.consequences: Apply local automatic-update policy on supported unmanaged editions. Manual updates remain available. A dated restoration task is required. Changes run only after confirmation; scheduled features create protected recovery files and Windows tasks.

commands.name: Resume previous automatic-update policy
commands.description: Restore the exact original NoAutoUpdate value or remove the toolbox-created value.
commands.consequences: Restore the exact original NoAutoUpdate value or remove the toolbox-created value. Changes run only after confirmation; scheduled features create protected recovery files and Windows tasks.

commands.name: Schedule shutdown / restart
commands.description: Schedule a local power action from one second through seven days. It continues after closing the toolbox. Force can lose unsaved data.
commands.consequences: Schedule a local power action from one second through seven days. It continues after closing the toolbox. Force can lose unsaved data. Changes run only after confirmation; scheduled features create protected recovery files and Windows tasks.

commands.name: Cancel toolbox power countdown
commands.description: Cancel a pending toolbox-owned power action before Windows is asked to shut down. Other applications' shutdowns are untouched.
commands.consequences: Cancel a pending toolbox-owned power action before Windows is asked to shut down. Other applications' shutdowns are untouched. Changes run only after confirmation; scheduled features create protected recovery files and Windows tasks.

commands.name: Power countdown status
commands.description: Display recorded toolbox power deadlines and state.
commands.consequences: Queries local information without applying repairs.

commands.name: Force restart now
commands.description: Immediately request a forced restart. Applications close without saving; unsaved work can be lost.
commands.consequences: Immediately request a forced restart. Applications close without saving; unsaved work can be lost. Changes run only after confirmation; scheduled features create protected recovery files and Windows tasks.

commands.name: Toolbox changes and restoration status
commands.description: Inspect recorded changes, deadlines, manual modes, restoration failures and conflicts.
commands.consequences: Queries local information without applying repairs.

commands.name: Windows activation and license
commands.description: Windows Software Licensing status, partial product key and remaining grace minutes.
commands.consequences: Queries local licensing metadata without modifying activation state.

commands.name: Signed and third-party drivers
commands.description: List installed Plug and Play drivers (third-party by default, or all signed drivers).
commands.consequences: Queries signed driver metadata without modifying drivers.

commands.name: Installed applications
commands.description: Inventory installed software from 64-bit, 32-bit and user Uninstall registry keys.
commands.consequences: Reads registry uninstall keys without triggering MSI package repair.

commands.name: Power plans and sleep states
commands.description: Active power scheme, available power plans and supported sleep states (S0/S3/Hibernate).
commands.consequences: Queries power configuration without changing the active scheme.

commands.name: Listening ports and processes
commands.description: Active TCP listeners and UDP endpoints mapped to their owning process name and PID.
commands.consequences: Queries active socket bindings without modifying firewall or processes.

commands.name: Wi-Fi radio and saved profiles
commands.description: Wireless adapter signal, radio band and saved WLAN profile names (passwords omitted).
commands.consequences: Queries WLAN interface and profile names without revealing security keys.

commands.name: Windows hosts file
commands.description: Inspect active non-comment hostname overrides in System32\drivers\etc\hosts.
commands.consequences: Reads the local hosts file without editing entries.

commands.name: System and WinHTTP proxy
commands.description: Current user Internet Settings proxy, PAC URL and system WinHTTP proxy state.
commands.consequences: Queries proxy settings without changing network configuration.

commands.name: Release and renew DHCP lease
commands.description: Run ipconfig /release followed by ipconfig /renew across active adapters.
commands.consequences: Temporarily interrupts network connections while renewing DHCP leases.

commands.name: Connected USB devices
commands.description: Enumerates Plug and Play USB devices, controllers, manufacturers and status.
commands.consequences: Queries connected USB device metadata without changing drivers.

commands.name: Connected displays and EDID
commands.description: Monitor EDID manufacturer, model, serial, year and active display resolution.
commands.consequences: Queries display and EDID metadata without changing display settings.

commands.name: TPM and Secure Boot status
commands.description: Check UEFI Secure Boot state and Trusted Platform Module readiness.
commands.consequences: Queries TPM and UEFI Secure Boot status without changing firmware or keys.

commands.name: Largest files in directory
commands.description: Find the largest files in a local folder without following reparse points (50,000 file scan cap).
commands.consequences: Reads directory metadata only; skips reparse points and inaccessible folders.

commands.name: Network shares and mapped drives
commands.description: Local SMB shares and current user mapped network drives.
commands.consequences: Queries share and mapped drive metadata without modifying permissions.

commands.name: Top CPU and memory processes
commands.description: Top 15 processes by memory working set and top 15 by cumulative CPU time.
commands.consequences: Snapshots running process resource usage without stopping processes.

commands.name: Non-Microsoft scheduled tasks
commands.description: Scheduled tasks outside \Microsoft\Windows\* along with state and configured action.
commands.consequences: Queries Task Scheduler metadata without enabling, disabling or running tasks.

commands.name: Stopped automatic services
commands.description: Windows services configured for Automatic startup that are currently not running.
commands.consequences: Queries service status without starting or modifying services.

commands.name: BSOD crash and minidump history
commands.description: Check Windows Minidump, MEMORY.DMP and recent BugCheck / Kernel-Power events (30 days).
commands.consequences: Inspects dump file metadata and System crash events without altering dumps.

commands.name: Boot, shutdown and wake history
commands.description: System event log timeline for startups, unexpected shutdowns and sleep/wake transitions.
commands.consequences: Reads bounded System log power/boot events without changing settings.

commands.name: Print Spooler and print queue
commands.description: Spooler service status, installed printers and any queued or stuck print jobs.
commands.consequences: Queries printer and spooler state without clearing jobs or restarting services.

commands.name: Local Administrators members
commands.description: Members of the local Administrators group resolved via well-known SID S-1-5-32-544.
commands.consequences: Queries local Administrators membership without modifying accounts or groups.

commands.name: Expiring certificates
commands.description: Personal certificates in LocalMachine\My and CurrentUser\My that are expired or expiring soon.
commands.consequences: Reads certificate expiration metadata without exporting private keys or modifying stores.

commands.name: Restart Print Spooler and clear queue
commands.description: Stop Spooler, delete stuck files inside System32\spool\PRINTERS, and restart Spooler.
commands.consequences: Deletes all queued spool files on this machine and restarts the Print Spooler service.

commands.name: Rebuild icon and thumbnail cache
commands.description: Stop Explorer, delete current user iconcache_*.db and thumbcache_*.db files, and restart Explorer.
commands.consequences: Closes all File Explorer windows briefly while clearing cached icon and thumbnail databases.

commands.name: Reset TCP/IP stack
commands.description: Run netsh int ip reset to restore default IPv4/IPv6 stack configuration.
commands.consequences: Resets TCP/IP registry configuration and may remove static IP settings. A restart is typically required.
